column1: # 5 GiB guest reservation, of which 4.375 GiB is the virtual-address alias region.
# Snowdrop experimentally reserves 4 GiB of virtual addresses after main's
# build-gated cuts (1.5 GiB large + 512 MiB 512 KiB slabs + 2 GiB 64 KiB slabs).
# This leaves about 320 MiB of alias address space past the engine reservation
# and the SDK's 62 MiB node area, subject to earlier small reservations.
# Virtual reservation is not physical commitment; memory usage needs gameplay checks.
# Snowdrop asks for interval 2 (30 fps). The host's presentation cap keeps that
# as the default and lets the launcher offer 60 fps; the game's elapsed-time
# step was checked during iPhone gameplay with one present per 60 Hz tick.
# Repository shader tables are placeholders; the privately extracted 4615-key
# version-complete v1.05 shaders live in the game work folder, not in Git.
